name: M'ONDUNIQ LEPIREV™ Dermolipid lifting and barrier-repairing eye cream
shortDescription: Anti-wrinkle eye cream with a lifting effect for intensive care of the sensitive, delicate skin around the eyes – dermolipid formula, 93% ingredients of natural origin. 30 ml.
description:
A rich yet gentle anti-wrinkle eye cream with a lifting effect, developed for intensive care of the sensitive, delicate skin around the eyes. It helps improve the skin's firmness, hydration and smoothness, and reduce the visibility of fine lines and wrinkles.

The dermolipid formula, made with MONDOCEUTICALS™ technology, supports the regeneration of the skin barrier around the eyes while nourishing and softening the skin. With regular use, the eye area can look smoother, more elastic and more cared for.

93% of the formula's ingredients are of natural origin (ISO 16128).
